# Concorde Career College

> > Concorde Career College offers 20+ accredited healthcare training programs across multiple U.S. campuses, from nursing and dental to diagnostic imaging and allied health careers.

Concorde Career College is a network of healthcare-focused career colleges providing hands-on training in high-demand medical professions. With campuses in major cities including Memphis, Jacksonville, Kansas City, Denver, Dallas, San Diego, and Portland, Concorde specializes in associate degree and diploma programs designed for rapid career entry into the healthcare industry.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare education
- Nursing programs (RN, LPN, LVN)
- Dental programs (Assistant, Hygiene)
- Diagnostic imaging (Sonography, Radiology)
- Allied health careers
- Associate degree programs
- Career training
- Clinical hands-on training
- Licensing exam preparation
- Multiple campus locations
- Program enrollment
- Career advancement pathways
- Accredited programs
- Patient care training
- Healthcare workforce development

## Nursing Programs

- [Find Nursing Programs Near You](https://www.concorde.edu/nursing-programs): Overview of nursing programs including LVN/LPN and RN pathways
- [Nursing Degree Programs](https://www.concorde.edu/nursing-programs/nursing-pre-licensure): Pre-licensure RN degree programs at multiple Concorde locations
- [Practical Nursing and Vocational Nursing Programs](https://www.concorde.edu/nursing-programs/practical-vocational-nursing): LPN/LVN practical nursing diploma and vocational programs
- [Go from RN to BSN Online](https://www.concorde.edu/nursing-programs/rn-bsn): Online RN to BSN completion program for career advancement

## Diagnostic Imaging & Technology Programs

- [Diagnostic Medical Sonography Programs and More](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs): Diagnostic programs including sonography, radiology, and related fields
- [Diagnostic Medical Sonography Programs](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs/diagnostic-medical-sonography): Diagnostic medical sonography associate degree for ultrasound technologists
- [Find a Cardiac Sonography Program](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs/cardiovascular-sonography): Cardiac sonography associate degree program at multiple campuses
- [Associate Degrees in Radiology](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs/radiologic-technology): Radiologic technology associate degree with hands-on clinical training
- [Neurodiagnostic Technologist Training](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs/neurodiagnostic-technology): Neurodiagnostic technology associate degree program overview
- [Polysomnographic Technology Programs](https://www.concorde.edu/diagnostic-programs/polysomnographic-technology): Polysomnographic technology diploma for sleep technologist careers

## Dental Programs

- [Dental Assistant and Dental Hygiene Schools](https://www.concorde.edu/dental-programs): Dental assistant and dental hygiene program offerings overview
- [Dental Assistant Program](https://www.concorde.edu/dental-programs/dental-assistant): Dental assistant diploma and associate degree program details
- [Concorde Dental Hygiene Program](https://www.concorde.edu/dental-programs/dental-hygiene): CODA-accredited dental hygiene associate degree program

## Patient Care & Allied Health Programs

- [Patient Care Technician Training Programs](https://www.concorde.edu/patient-care-programs): Patient care programs including respiratory therapy and surgical technology
- [Find a physical therapist assistant Program Near You](https://www.concorde.edu/patient-care-programs/physical-therapist-assistant): CAPTE-accredited physical therapist assistant associate degree programs
- [Occupational Therapy Assistant Program](https://www.concorde.edu/patient-care-programs/occupational-therapy-assistant): Occupational therapy assistant associate degree program
- [Massage Therapy Schools](https://www.concorde.edu/patient-care-programs/massage-therapy): Massage therapy diploma with MBLEx licensing exam preparation
